hero.title: RabCab AutoCAD Plugin Suite
hero.tagline: Enterprise-grade CAD automation tools for architectural and manufacturing workflows

sections.title: Technical Approach
sections.content: Developed a modular AutoCAD plugin architecture using C# and the AutoCAD .NET API. The solution features over 100 custom commands organized into specialized suites, each targeting specific industry workflows. Implemented intelligent agents for automated processing and created custom UI components for enhanced user experience.

subsections.title: Plugin Architecture
subsections.content: Built a command-based system where each operation is a self-contained module, allowing for easy maintenance and extension. Used dependency injection for shared services and implemented a robust error handling framework.

subsections.title: Multi-Version Support
subsections.content: Engineered compatibility across AutoCAD 2013-2020 using conditional compilation and version-specific APIs, ensuring enterprise clients could use the plugin regardless of their AutoCAD version.

sections.title: Implementation Details
sections.content: The plugin suite includes specialized modules for annotation management, assembly processing, CNC toolpath generation, structural design, and carpentry operations. Each module integrates seamlessly with AutoCAD's native commands while providing enhanced functionality.

sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: RabCab transformed CAD workflows across multiple industries with 100+ custom commands, achieving 75% time reduction for complex assemblies. Zero-error automated assembly management and seamless integration with Excel, PDF, and 3D applications.

sections.title: Productivity Gains
highlights: 100+ custom commands covering all major CAD workflows
75% reduction in time for BOM generation and dimensioning
Seamless integration with Excel, PDF, and 3D applications

sections.title: Industry Adoption
sections.summary: Used by architects, manufacturers, and construction firms. Multi-version support across AutoCAD 2013-2020 ensures enterprise compatibility.

devops.name: Installer Generation
devops.code:
<!-- RabCab.wxs -->
<Product Id="*" Name="RabCab AutoCAD Suite" Version="$(var.Version)">
  <Package InstallerVersion="200" Compressed="yes"/>
  
  <Feature Id="MainFeature" Title="RabCab">
    <ComponentGroupRef Id="ProductComponents"/>
  </Feature>
  
  <ComponentGroup Id="ProductComponents">
    <Component Directory="AutoCADPlugins">
      <File Source="$(var.BuildDir)\RabCab.dll"/>
      <RegistryKey Root="HKCU"
        Key="Software\Autodesk\AutoCAD\$(var.AcadVersion)\Applications\RabCab">
        <RegistryValue Name="LOADER" Value="[INSTALLFOLDER]RabCab.dll"/>
        <RegistryValue Name="LOADCTRLS" Value="14" Type="integer"/>
      </RegistryKey>
    </Component>
  </ComponentGroup>
</Product>
